first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A first-person person, with only the hands wearing purple-black gloves and part of the warm-brown forearms visible, holding a knife in the right hand.

entities.name: white locker group with blue lettering
entities.identification: A row of off-white tall cabinets to the image-left of the observation window, with blue-gray handwritten graffiti on some cabinet doors.

entities.name: industrial corridor observation window
entities.identification: A wide rectangular glass window on the locker-room wall, with a gray frame and a vertical divider in the middle.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The purple-blue pointed knife held in Person A's right hand, with serrations on the spine and a guard in front of the handle.

entities.name: white locker group beside the doorway
entities.identification: The nearby off-white cabinet group beside the doorway; the cabinet doors visible in this clip bear thick black graffiti.

entities.name: wet, shiny ground outside the window
entities.identification: The gray reflective floor in the lower part of the corridor behind the observation window.

entities.name: industrial building outside the window
entities.identification: The gray building walls on both sides of the corridor behind the observation window; the nearby wall on the right is darker.

entities.name: square container outside the window
entities.identification: The gray upright box-shaped object in the distance in the corridor behind the window.

entities.name: light-colored locker-room wall
entities.identification: The indoor light-beige wall panels and wall corner, with a locally dark base.

entities.name: gray-brown locker-room floor
entities.identification: The indoor gray-brown floor, with a yellow boundary line in front of the facilities.

entities.name: indoor metal grid ceiling
entities.identification: The dark-gray overhead beams and grid ceiling indoors.

entities.name: long overhead light fixture
entities.identification: The slender white light fixture below the ceiling; the main fixture has parallel illuminated tubes.

entities.name: metal sink by the wall
entities.identification: Two light-gray metal sinks side by side along the rear wall, with backsplashes and small faucets.

entities.name: white protective suit
entities.identification: The white coverall hanging to the image-right of the observation window, with sleeves and separated trouser legs visible.

entities.name: white round helmet
entities.identification: One white round-topped helmet above the hanging garment.

entities.name: black hanging rod
entities.identification: The slender dark hanging rod mounted along the wall above the white protective suit.

entities.name: wood-colored bench
entities.identification: The bench below the white protective suit, with part of its wood-colored seat surface visible in the image.

entities.name: light-colored cylindrical container in the washing area
entities.identification: The upright light-beige cylindrical container to the right of the sinks, with a dark upper rim and a blue-gray label on its body.

entities.name: white cabinet group without graffiti
entities.identification: The plain light-colored group of tall cabinet doors visible on the right side of the washing area.
